parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy is trying to turn Gemma against me by painting me as an extortionist. He's also lying or being hypocritical—he just claimed he has no brick, yet he's trying to trade for hers. Gemma already rejected him, so I don't need to intervene heavily, but a small jab at his transparency might help keep the focus on his own scarcity.
parsed.note_to_self: Jimmy is actively lobbying against me. Gemma is holding onto her brick tightly and values it higher than a 1:1 wheat trade. Brick remains the bottleneck for everyone.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'ימי, לפני רגע אמרת שאין לך טיט בכלל, עכשיו פתאום אתה מחפש אותו? נראה שמי שבאמת מנסה לעשות פה מהלכים מתחת לרדאר זה אתה.
